purpose: Test source-only practical augmentation of a frozen six-class E51 rejection readout, separating threshold-only recalibration from new binary membership fitting

frozen_sources.encoder: uniform_oe E51, original E50 plus 222 fixed source updates, cumulative 11322
frozen_sources.geometry: Original clean source_L6300 geometry; no four-view refit
frozen_sources.identity_head: Original jointly trained six-class default head; frozen, not replaced
frozen_sources.restorer: DURA v1.0 R69 E20/4940, FP32/TF32off, reuse=true graph=true native=false

source_L.permission: Known source labels; only membership is used by binary readout fitting

exposure_train.permission: Original four-OE source membership only; no TX/y field

source_V.permission: Known labels for threshold calibration and evaluation only; no readout fit or early stopping

novel_validation.permission: No TX/y in compact export; consume descriptors only after both arm thresholds freeze; independent scorer truth only

source_data.data_validation: Reuse existing VALIDATED_ONCE source roles; no Full/ZIP/member revalidation

view_generation.practical: Canonical ResidualChannel once then frozen DURA, no second RMS or EQ

source_data.compact_export: Each role/view: ids, descriptor100 FP32, static5 FP64, logits6 FP32, baseline_closed, rx_i, day_i; y only source_L/source_V; no raw IQ or full branch bank
source_data.baseline_policy: Same-input original F closed for V/novel; L/OE baseline=-2 sentinel, no unused original-F training-role forwards

readouts.calibration_only: Copy original linear/MLP parameters and mean/std exactly; zero new readout fit steps

augmented_readout.loss: Original 0.5 mean softplus(-known) + 0.5 mean softplus(OE), full batch

calibration.population: Same known source_V four views, 27000 unique physical records / 108000 view exposures
calibration.encoder_closed_loss_0_005: Diagnostic only, not a hard goal
calibration.threshold_rule: One maximal legal global scalar per method/arm; accept score>=tau, intact ties; exact Fraction budgets; min of per-group maxima
calibration.no_rejection_infeasible: Use global minimum score to accept all and report false; thresholds cannot repair encoder damage

development.old_D0: Exact completed C0/P1 prediction references; no duplicate old forward
development.current_arms: One shared current frozen E51/G forward per condition, identical descriptor/static5/closed predictions for both arms
development.baseline: Same-input original F baseline reused from completed D0
development.historical_current_closed_difference: Report counts/comparability if numerical execution differs; no rerun to force equality
development.C0: Isolated clean public schema, no practical or DURA
development.P1: Existing fixed star received through the same frozen DURA; no clean per-record reference
development.unknown_role_reporting: Historical dataset roles only in scorer; no U is read in this run, so no current-run unknown is adapted or newly registered

evaluation.known_acceptance_objective: Maximize while preserving rejection and identity

execution.technical_stop_rule: Wrong source/role/handle, forbidden truth/fit/reference, nonfinite, output collision or failure to produce legal predictions: preserve partial and stop without score-driven retry

claim_scope: Source development plus previously exposed RX24-1 development confirmation, not independent novel-TX or strict new-date validation; no target adaptation, unknown clustering, anonymous registration or formal RX24-18 evidence
